sources.summary: 作者称 Verified AI 迎来标志性月份，Axiom 的 AI 智能体集群用 24 天完成数学史上最长证明的验证，将跨越 500 多篇论文的 15,000 页有限单群分类定理（CFSG）转化为 3800 万行以上机器验证代码，并发现已发表记录中的 34 处严重出入。引用内容补充称该形式化证明可能是最大的开源项目之一，图中显示 Axiom CFSG 达 43.0M 行，约每 37 天翻倍。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 一群 AI agents 核查了史上最长数学证明的每一步，数学家已依赖 Classification of Finite Simple Groups 40多年却无人能独自验完，文章记录 Verified AI 迄今最亮眼的一个月。

en.summary: The author says Verified AI had a landmark month: Axiom's swarm of AI agents verified the longest proof in mathematical history in 24 days, converting the 15,000-page Classification of Finite Simple Groups (CFSG)—spanning more than 500 papers—into over 38 million lines of machine-verified code and finding 34 serious discrepancies in the published record. The quoted material adds that the formal proof may be one of the largest open-source projects; a chart shows Axiom CFSG at 43.0M lines, doubling roughly every 37 days.
en.reason: An Axiom AI agent swarm verified the 15,000-page, 500-plus-paper Classification of Finite Simple Groups in 24 days, turning it into over 38 million lines of machine-checked code and flagging 34 serious discrepancies in the published record.

sources.summary: Anthropic 计划通过长期受益信托和 Founder LLC 等独特治理结构上市，在公开市场融资的同时防止股东迫使公司削弱安全投入。信托的五名投票受托人可通过 Class T 股票任命七名董事中的四席，七位创始人则以 Founder LLC 掌握 50.1% 投票权。法学专家认为法律层面可隔绝逐利压力，但市场竞争、融资需求和创始人离开都可能侵蚀这些保障。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic计划IPO，想靠public benefit corporation身份和限制股东影响董事会的治理设计抵御华尔街压力，Dario Amodei与Daniela Amodei均在董事会，但专家质疑其上市后难守安全优先。

en.summary: Anthropic plans to go public through unique governance structures such as a long-term benefit trust and Founder LLC, raising capital in public markets while preventing shareholders from forcing the company to weaken safety spending. The trust’s five voting trustees can appoint four of seven board seats through Class T stock, while the seven founders control 50.1% of voting power via Founder LLC. Legal experts say the structure can legally insulate the company from profit-driven pressure, but market competition, financing needs and founder departures could all erode these safeguards.
en.reason: Anthropic plans an IPO with a public benefit corporation, a five-trustee long-term benefit trust appointing four of seven directors via Class T shares, and a Founder LLC holding 50.1% voting power, as experts question whether safety-first governance survives market pressure.

en.reason: Amazon’s $18 billion Anthropic investment—including $6.2 billion in convertible notes it values at $97.9 billion and $10 billion in non-voting preferred stock—makes it the IPO’s biggest beneficiary, with Anthropic committed to at least $110 billion in AWS spending.

sources.title: OpenAI 请外部专家核查其 AI 在数学、计算机科学和物理学领域产出的证明 / OpenAI asks outside experts, including a Nobel laureate, to check proofs its AI produced in math, computer science, and physics
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 请外部专家核查其 AI 在数学、计算机科学和物理学领域产出的证明

sources.summary: The Decoder 报道 OpenAI 请外部专家担任"shepherds"核查其 AI 在计算机科学、数学和物理学领域的三项证明结果，并将部分证明翻译成 Lean 供计算机逐步验证。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI 称内部 AI 模型用 Lean 形式化证明，已推翻计算机科学中关于 SAT 的 ETH 核心假设并证明部分 Millennium Prize Problem，外部专家正核验，若成立数百篇论文将失去基础。

en.summary: The Decoder reports that OpenAI brought in outside experts to serve as "shepherds" and vet three proofs its AI produced in computer science, mathematics, and physics, and translated some of the proofs into Lean for step-by-step computer verification.
en.reason: OpenAI has enlisted outside “shepherds,” including a Nobel laureate, to verify AI-generated Lean proofs in computer science, math and physics, among them a claimed refutation of the ETH for SAT that could undercut hundreds of papers.
